items.h: Sui to add post-quantum signature schemes for quantum-safe accounts
items.s: Sui said users can adopt quantum-safe keys without creating a new recovery phrase or changing wallet addresses.

items.h: The Fed’s New Philosophy Could Be a Recipe for Interest Rate Volatility
Black Lake Launches Harbor Verify to Bring Verifiable Credit to Onchain Markets
items.s: Black Lake Digital Markets has launched Harbor Verify, a browser-based tool that lets investors, lenders, auditors, and rating agencies independently confirm that every loan in a tokenized pool belongs there and passed its published eligibility rules, without seeing private borrower data.

items.h: Crypto bill ethics provision could let Trump defer millions in taxes: Bloomberg
items.s: President Trump is reviewing ethics language in a bid to pass cryptocurrency legislation — which could result in a personal tax benefit.
alt: Proposed CLARITY ethics deal could save Trump millions in taxes: Bloomberg

items.h: “We Need Clarity,” Says Former New York Governor Andrew Cuomo
items.s: Bitcoin Magazine “We Need Clarity,” Says Former New York Governor Andrew Cuomo The ex-New York governor hinted that Democrats were playing politics with the Clarity Act. This post “We Need Clarity,” Says Former New York Governor Andrew Cuomo first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Mathew Di Salvo .

items.h: SEC Bought a Billion Airline Records to Track Travelers—Likely Without a Warrant
items.s: The financial regulator subscribed to a global flight database covering more than a billion tickets to monitor activity.

items.h: Wintermute registers as SEC broker-dealer to trade stocks, options and crypto ETFs
items.s: Wintermute USA is a New York-based subsidiary that has registered as a broker-dealer with the SEC and FINRA.

items.h: ether.fi Removes Restaking From weETH, Nearing A Full EigenLayer Exit
items.s: Restaking exposure moves into weETHs, a separate token built on Symbiotic. CEO Mike Silagadze: “End of an era. Sad.”

items.h: Bitcoin miners MARA and CleanSpark post double-digit revenue drops as AI infrastructure pivot continues
items.s: MARA's net loss widened to $611.3 million, or $1.60 per diluted share, while CleanSpark’s was $239.8 million, or $0.89 per basic share.
